fields.label: User
fields.description: User who asked for the write and who alone may approve it.

fields.label: Principal
fields.description: Identity type that opened the proposal.

fields.label: Session ID
fields.description: Conversation id sent by the client. Untrusted text.

fields.label: Tool
fields.description: Name of the write tool that will run after approval.

fields.label: Tool Class
fields.description: Kind of the tool: write, admin or app.

fields.label: Target DocType
fields.description: DocType the write is aimed at.

fields.label: Target Name
fields.description: Document the write is aimed at. Empty for a new document.

fields.label: Target Key
fields.description: Hash of the target. Blocks a blind retry on the same target.

fields.label: Target Version
fields.description: Version marker of the target when the preview was made.

fields.label: Arguments
fields.description: Validated tool arguments as JSON. Never holds a secret field.

fields.label: Preview
fields.description: What the human sees before approving, as JSON.

fields.label: Digest
fields.description: SHA-256 that binds an approval to this exact preview.

fields.label: Destructive
fields.description: Set when the tool may destroy or overwrite data.

fields.label: Billable
fields.description: Set when the tool may cost money.

fields.label: Expires At
fields.description: Moment after which the proposal can no longer be approved.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Where the proposal stands. Consumed means execution has started.

fields.label: Result
fields.description: Outcome of the execution. Unknown blocks new proposals on the same target.

fields.label: Result Document
fields.description: Name of the document the execution touched.

fields.label: Error
fields.description: Why the proposal was rejected or the execution failed.

fields.label: Decided At
fields.description: When a human approved, rejected or resolved the proposal.
